rev.t:
Compared to other Pepper fry experience centers I visited, this is a smaller one.
Items on display are mostly limited to living room furnitures. …
The staff of the store Pooja and Rajesh were really courteous and helpful. Made our buying decision very seamless. Recommended.
HSR pepperfry studio having very good collections.I have purchased one bed that is very good finish and made with strong wood. It's having very good quality. Thank you pepperfry
